about: A local preview of the site once the current rounds ship: python3 website/build.py --preview website/preview/upcoming.json writes website/dist-preview/. Never deployed. Planned entries carry their planned date, and every claim stays Soon. What 0.8.0 holds isn't settled yet, so no entry, preview link or claim is planned for it: add them here once it is.
